name: Relov
description: An Azorius Arbiter who signs applications without care, dismisses a complainant over a spelling error, and receives a letter from Javy.

timeline.summary: Javy leads Relov to a tenement where he sees Zivan's corpse, words carved into every inch of his skin.
timeline.quote: Words had been magically imprinted over every inch of the dead man's body.

timeline.summary: Javy asks about Zivan; Relov recounts that he was a respected Arbiter who squandered his talent in Rakdos pleasure houses.
timeline.quote: But he squandered it in Rakdos pleasure houses and hasn't been one of us for quite some time.

timeline.summary: Javy shows Relov an old Mass Arrest Order for the Golgari Undercity sweep and points out that everyone who signed it is dead except him.
timeline.quote: "They're all dead," she said. "Except for you."

timeline.summary: Javy explains that someone is slaughtering Azorius in the manner in which they lived their lives, and warns Relov.
timeline.quote: Someone is... slaughtering people in the manner in which they lived their lives,

timeline.summary: Relov files an Application for Constant Protection on returning to New Prahv.
timeline.quote: As soon as Relov got back to New Prahv, he filled out an Application for Constant Protection.

timeline.summary: Javy visits Relov's townhouse at midnight and confronts him about signing the order for the Golgari raid.
Javy tells Relov she has found a new teacher who holds the truth about life and death, and that those who disturb the cycle must experience a profound death.
timeline.quote: I have found a new teacher, and she eclipses my work with the Boros,

timeline.summary: Vraska enters, and Javy warns Relov not to look at her face as the gorgon sweeps into the room.
timeline.quote: "Don't look her in the face," Javy ordered Relov as the gorgon swept into the room.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Relov she was cast into a dark tomb just before a guard would have killed her, and resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.
timeline.quote: I resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.

timeline.summary: Vraska lets Javy choose Relov's death, and Javy names inaction.
Relov is turned to stone, and his statue is installed near the main gate and mistaken for one of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: No one looked long enough to see the uncanny resemblance to the missing Relov or the terror in his unblinking eyes.

timeline.summary: Relov processes paperwork, dismissing Mr. Lapt's application over a spelling error and approving a new statue of Grand Arbiter Leonos.
timeline.quote: Learn to spell, Mr. Lapt, and stop wasting my precious time.

timeline.summary: Relov signs an Orzhov enforcer's urgent application despite twelve statute violations when he sees the bribe amount.
timeline.quote: The request violated twelve statutes, but when Relov saw the pale pink number printed at the bottom, he signed without hesitation.

timeline.summary: Relov receives a cryptic letter from Javy asking him to come, after a year of silence since she and her partner were attacked.
timeline.quote: What is the culmination of a life of words? Buckets of blood. Come now.

relations.note: One of his oldest friends, though she ultimately delivers him to Vraska.
relations.quote: but coming from one of his oldest friends, it was downright repugnant.

relations.note: He killed Relov's proposal for stricter limits on executions.
relations.quote: his proposal had been killed by Grand Arbiter Leonos a year ago.

relations.note: She petrifies him with Javy's chosen death of inaction.
relations.quote: The gorgon placed her thumbs on Relov's eyelids.

pages_say.description: An Azorius Arbiter in New Prahv who signs edicts without thinking about their effects and is targeted by Javy and Vraska.
An Azorius Arbiter who signs applications without care, dismisses a complainant over a spelling error, and receives a letter from Javy.
